nodes.label: Siamese Training Curve
nodes.rationale: Two-panel chart (accuracy, loss vs epoch, 100 epochs) of Siamese network training. Train accuracy reaches ~0.99 while validation plateaus ~0.90-0.91 from epoch ~20. Train loss falls steadily to ~0.04; validation loss bottoms at ~0.30 around epoch 15-30 then climbs to ~0.42, i.e. clear overfitting after ~20-30 epochs; early stopping would help.

nodes.label: F1-score
nodes.rationale: Train ~0.99, validation plateau ~0.91 by epoch 100.

nodes.label: Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC)
nodes.rationale: Train ~0.98, validation plateau ~0.81-0.82 by epoch 100.

nodes.label: Siamese Training Metrics Plot
nodes.rationale: Two-panel training curve (F1-score and MCC vs epoch, 100 epochs) for a Siamese network. Train F1 climbs to ~0.99 and train MCC to ~0.98; validation plateaus around epoch 20-30 at F1 ~0.91 and MCC ~0.81-0.82. Growing train/validation gap after ~20 epochs indicates mild overfitting; early stopping near epoch 30 would give similar validation performance.

nodes.label: Train/Validation Gap (Overfitting)
nodes.rationale: Validation metrics flatten after ~20-30 epochs while train keeps rising, a ~0.08 F1 / ~0.17 MCC gap at end.

nodes.label: Intelligent Antibodies Logo (Y-shaped antibody icon)
nodes.rationale: Teal stylized Y-shaped immunoglobulin (IgG antibody) silhouette with heavy/light chain arms; used as app branding.

nodes.label: Siamese Network Training Curves
nodes.rationale: Two-panel chart (accuracy and loss vs epoch, ~19 epochs) for training and validation sets of a Siamese model. Training accuracy rises 0.56 -> 0.93; validation accuracy plateaus ~0.87-0.88 from epoch ~9. Training loss falls 0.68 -> 0.18; validation loss plateaus ~0.32-0.33 after epoch ~9 with noise. Gap widening after epoch ~8 indicates mild overfitting; early stopping around epoch 9-13 would be appropriate.

nodes.label: Siamese Accuracy Curve (train vs validation)
nodes.rationale: Validation accuracy peaks ~0.878 near epoch 17; train reaches ~0.93.

nodes.label: Siamese Loss Curve (train vs validation)
nodes.rationale: Validation loss stalls ~0.31-0.33 while training loss keeps decreasing to ~0.18: overfitting signal.

nodes.label: VAE KL Divergence Loss (mislabeled)
nodes.rationale: Red curve is labeled 'Reconstruction Loss' a second time in the legend (labeling bug); by elimination it is likely the KL term. Rises from ~0 to ~15 by epoch ~40 and stays flat, a small fraction of total loss.

nodes.label: VAE Reconstruction Loss
nodes.rationale: Green curve tracks total loss almost exactly, ending ~300; it accounts for nearly all of the objective.

nodes.label: VAE Total Loss
nodes.rationale: Blue curve: ~2670 at epoch 0, ~310 at epoch 250; steady slow decline after epoch ~20.

nodes.label: VAE Training History Chart
nodes.rationale: Line chart of VAE loss vs epoch over ~250 epochs. Total loss and reconstruction loss drop sharply from ~2670 to ~850 within the first few epochs, then decay slowly to ~310 by epoch 250 without fully plateauing. Reconstruction loss dominates total loss. Title has typo 'Traning'.

nodes.label: SAbDab data pipeline (four ordered scripts)
nodes.rationale: Each script resolves its own paths relative to the repo root so it works from anywhere, and downloads skip ids already present so the fetch stage is resumable.

nodes.label: SAbDab antibody-antigen dataset
nodes.rationale: X-ray-crystallography immune complexes across many species; the dataset the current pipeline actually trains on.

nodes.label: All_PDB_files.txt - antigen-antibody structure id list
nodes.rationale: One id per constitutive antigen-antibody structure, e.g. 5kel_Q_U_I: first four characters are the RCSB PDB id, the remainder identify the chains inside that structure.

nodes.label: positive_samples.txt - known interacting structure pairs
nodes.rationale: Tab-separated pairs of structure ids known to form immune complexes, including self-pairs; the relation is reciprocal and unordered, and anything absent is treated as a negative sample.

nodes.label: SAbDab unfetched.txt - concatenated unretrieved PDB ids
nodes.norm_label: sabdab unfetched.txt - concatenated unretrieved pdb ids
nodes.rationale: A single unnewlined run-on string of 4-character PDB ids, written without separators - an artefact of the fetch stage rather than a curated list, making it hard to parse compared with the repo-root unfetched.txt.

nodes.label: fetched.txt - successfully fetched PDB ids
nodes.rationale: 907 four-character PDB ids, one per line, the resumable fetch log that lets download_pdbs.py skip ids it already has.

nodes.label: unfetched.txt - failed fetch log
nodes.rationale: Ten 'Failed to fetch <id>' lines; these download failures are exactly the gap filter_interaction_table.py exists to drop from the training table.

nodes.label: Reciprocal, unordered positive-pair relation
nodes.rationale: Either partner of a positive pair can be the antibody or the antigen side, so the filter step checks both orderings; any pair not listed is treated as a negative sample.

nodes.label: index.html SPA mount point (#app, /src/main.js)
nodes.rationale: Standard Vite single-page shell: an empty #app div plus an ES-module script tag, so all UI is mounted at runtime from src/main.js.

nodes.label: CoV-AbDab SARS-CoV antibody/antigen dataset
nodes.rationale: Included for future work; not yet wired into the training scripts.

nodes.label: Interactive 2-D latent-space exploration with box/lasso selection
nodes.norm_label: interactive 2-d latent-space exploration with box/lasso selection
nodes.rationale: Box or lasso selection over sampled latent points filters every other tab to that selection, making clusters of the latent space the unit of analysis.

nodes.label: One-hot sequence encoding
nodes.rationale: One-hot is the encoding both shipped models use; k-mer / Prot-Vec style encoders and Chaos Game Representation were explored during prototyping but not adopted.

nodes.label: CoV-AbDab independent test set (held out)
nodes.rationale: 106 rows in the same three-column layout, kept out of training as an independent evaluation set.

nodes.label: CoV-AbDab negative dataset (non-interacting pairs)
nodes.rationale: 1710 rows in the same three-column layout as the positive set - already far smaller than the positive set, the inverse of the SAbDab class imbalance.

nodes.label: CoV-AbDab positive dataset (interacting heavy/light pairs)
nodes.rationale: 9309 tab-separated rows: SARS-CoV1 / SARS-CoV2 label plus two amino-acid sequence columns (heavy- and light-chain style), the interacting class.

nodes.label: Intelligent Antibodies project
nodes.rationale: Antibody design is slow, expensive and relies on in-vitro screening plus hard-to-compute binding-energy estimates; the project explores an in-silico alternative that turns candidate discovery into rejection sampling in a learned latent space instead of a physics-based energy calculation.

nodes.label: Earlier Flask + Vue.js web prototype (superseded)
nodes.rationale: Superseded by the Streamlit app under app/ but kept in the repo for reference.

nodes.label: intelligent-antibodies-view Vue 3 + Vite scaffold
nodes.rationale: Unmodified Vue 3 + Vite starter README (VSCode + Volar recommendation, npm install / dev / build), confirming the frontend was never taken past the generated scaffold.

nodes.label: Flask backend + Vue/Vite frontend prototype setup
nodes.norm_label: flask backend + vue/vite frontend prototype setup
nodes.rationale: NodeJS 18.3 frontend with sass, axios, vuex and bio-pv, driven against a conda-installed Flask app - the dependencies are installed ad hoc by npm commands in the README rather than declared, and a 'vuepython' bridge is listed.

nodes.label: Deep learning benchmark for antibody-antigen binding (motivating article)
nodes.norm_label: deep learning benchmark for antibody-antigen binding (motivating article)

nodes.label: Approximate custom Siamese metrics (accuracy / f1 / mcc)
nodes.norm_label: approximate custom siamese metrics (accuracy / f1 / mcc)
nodes.rationale: Simple, approximate formulas kept for continuity with earlier experiments rather than calibrated production-grade metrics - a known limitation of the research status of the project.

nodes.label: Convolutional VAE generator (2-D latent space)
nodes.rationale: Trained on antibody sequences only, one-hot encoded, Conv2D encoder / Conv2DTranspose decoder with a 2-D latent space so the sampled space stays directly plottable and explorable; sampling z = temperature x N(0,1) makes temperature an explicit knob trading sampling diversity against decode fidelity.

nodes.label: Negative-class downsampling (dataset balancing)
nodes.rationale: Real antibody-antigen pairs are overwhelmingly non-interacting, so the negative class is downsampled to match the positive one before fitting the classifier, otherwise the classifier would trivially predict 'no interaction'.

nodes.label: ESMFold structure prediction
nodes.rationale: ESMFold via the free public ESM Atlas API is used as a practical, GPU-cluster-free stand-in for AlphaFold2; it needs internet and can take about a minute, which is why folding is on demand behind a button rather than automatic. Structures are coloured by per-residue pLDDT using AlphaFold's own colour convention for familiarity.

nodes.label: Per-sequence-length model weights (vector_size encoding window)
nodes.rationale: Weights are stored per sequence length (200 aa default), so the dashboard loads the models trained for the chosen length and, when none exist, reports which lengths are trained and falls back to simulated results.

nodes.label: Rejection sampling of candidates
nodes.rationale: Candidates are sampled in batches and kept only if the predicted interaction score clears a threshold; the same loop is shared by the dashboard and the CLI so generation behaviour cannot diverge between the two entry points.

nodes.label: Schematic secondary-structure cartoon
nodes.rationale: A simplified secondary-structure heuristic gives every candidate an instant, offline, clearly-labelled illustrative cartoon, so the expensive real fold stays optional.

nodes.label: Siamese CNN+GRU interaction classifier
nodes.rationale: A shared Conv1D + bidirectional-GRU tower embeds both candidate antibody and target antigen so one learned representation serves both inputs; embeddings are combined and passed through a sigmoid to give an interaction probability usable as a cheap stand-in for binding-energy computation.

nodes.label: Simulated-results fallback mode
nodes.rationale: No pretrained weights are shipped, so the dashboard detects whether real models exist under run/models/ and otherwise shows clearly-labelled simulated results; this lets the interface be explored in under a minute with no data download or training, and the switch to real output needs no flag.
